verdict.rationale: Chronicle's first-party docs describe official SDKs in Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Go and Rust. Every SDK exposes the same resources with the same method names (e.g. `events.search(query)`), and the SDK is used for trace ingestion and querying. Missing for 10: package/install details and per-language reference depth, versioning or maturity info, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Automate workflows with Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, or Rust.
Every SDK exposes the same resources with the same method names, adjusted to the language's conventions.
then query them in Timeline or through the SDK
Use SDK trace ingestion or an OpenTelemetry exporter pointed at Chronicle.
